description: List branches, newest first, with owner, parent branch, head changeset, and comment. Read-only.

maxResults.description: Maximum branches to return, from 1 to 500. Default: 50.

nameLike.description: Optional substring of the branch name, for example task or release.

parent.description: Optional parent branch, for example /main, to list its child branches.

since.description: Optional creation date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: uvcs_branch_list
